title: swertia petiolata var. lahulensis
intro: Swertia petiolata var. lahulensis, commonly known as Lahul Swertia, is a plant species belonging to the Gentianaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly for its potential to treat various health conditions, including diabetes, fever, and inflammation. The health benefits of Lahul Swertia include its ability to lower blood sugar levels, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antimicrobial and antioxidant activities. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include gentiopicrin, gentiogentiobiose, and swertiamarin, among others, that contribute to its anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antidiabetic effects.
